items.title: Bobby Militello interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 14, 2002
items.q: Ronnie Foster and I used to skip out of school during lunch and go over to my brother’s place... Ronnie and I would go blow for a couple of hours

ctx.x: And he would let me out of gym all the time. He would get me out of gym constantly. As a matter of fact that was the thing, we couldn’t have — and then the other prerequisite with Sam was that I show up on time for the variety shows because we had — well you know Ronnie Foster? Well Ronnie was in the school with us, he was playing in the school. We had Joey Gaeta who is a guitar player that is out in L.A. who has done at least ten albums or so. And Jerry Panzico who has died recently but he was out in L.A. and a…

pay for it.” He says, “This is the last time.” And that’s the last time I think I was ever late on him. I used to have to play “Taps” because we didn’t have a trumpet player that could play taps, so on Memorial Day when we’d go to the park I’d bring my alto and just hold down low B flat and use the harmonic overtone series. [scats] And I was so egotistical even then, that I told him I would only use a school horn because I didn’t play my horn outside. What if it rained?
